name: bridge
description: Zero-dependency local command center for Claude Code: a native macOS app with a Kanban board of sessions, your GitHub PRs and Linear issues, and Slack threads run end to end by headless Claude workers in their own worktrees.

scripts.dev: ./scripts/install.sh stop >/dev/null; node server/render.js && BRIDGE_WRITE_HOME=1 node --watch-path=server server
